message: We've come to another indoor training hall.
The academy has around thirty of these indoor training halls, and each one can be reserved individually.
Momiji says she "can't concentrate if it's noisy around her," so she's training alone in a separate room.
Oh, she's at it, all right.
Momiji is sitting alone in the center of the room, doing zazen.

name: Miyako
message: 「What is Onee-chan doing？」

name: Iori
message: 「She's doing zazen to focus her mind.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm... I wonder if that really makes you stronger.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji is already plenty strong, you see. To get even stronger, she has to reach for far greater heights.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Whoa, it's amazing that you can get stronger just by sleeping.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Onee-chan is sleeping.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmn, zzz~...」
...Sigh, honestly, that girl.
I walk over and lean my face in close.

name: Iori
message: <s36>"Wake uuuuup！"</s>

name: Momiji
message: 「Waaaah？！ Fwah, huh... Is it morning already？！」
Momiji bolts upright in a panic.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Wh-what, it's just you, Sensei. Don't scare me like that!」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't fall asleep, Momiji. That doesn't count as training.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Easy for you to say, but anyone would normally fall asleep if they close their eyes and try not to think about anything.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I really don't think stuff like zazen suits me at all~」

name: Iori
message: 「You'll never reach the state of Shohou Muga with an attitude like that. If you want to get stronger, take it seriously.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeees...」
Suddenly, Momiji turns her gaze to Miyako-chan, standing next to me.

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh? What are you here for, Miyako?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Ehehe, Sensei's going to train me now!」
She looks really happy.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, so you asked for it yourself, huh?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, I didn’t have to ask Sis for help. I’m fine without her now.」

name: Momiji
message: 「O-ouch, that’s cold... You’re cold-hearted, Miyako~」

name: Iori
message: 「What about you, Momiji？ Want to watch？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, I think I’ll just watch from the sidelines. I want to see how much Miyako has grown, after all.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then let’s get started, Miyako-chan！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yay！ I’ve been waiting for this♪ Let’s go, let’s go！」

name: Iori
message: 「How long have you been practicing Jindou, Miyako-chan？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm... about three years. But in our family, we start practicing with wooden swords when we’re two.」

name: Iori
message: 「What an impressive elite education...」

name: Miyako
message: 「How long have you been doing it, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve been at it for about twenty years. I’m not quite at your level, but I’ve been doing various things since I was small, so counting all that, anyway.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I see, that’s why you’re strong!」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I wonder. I’ve seen plenty of people stronger than me, so I still feel I need to keep honing my skills.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I want to fight them too！ If I beat you, Sensei, will I get to？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, if you have enough strength to beat me, I imagine your opportunities to fight people like that will increase.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Then I’ll do my best to defeat you, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, yes, having that kind of challenging spirit is a good thing！」
She’s a pure, good girl, yet she possesses a strong fighting spirit.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, let’s begin！」
Drawing my Origami.

name: Miyako
message: 「Yes, let’s begin.」
Miyako-chan draws the Origami she brought with a smooth motion. Surprisingly, her stance is quite professional.

name: Iori
message: （...This kid is strong.）
Perhaps I should call it the aura radiating from her body. Just by facing her, I could feel a tingle in the air.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, first, try coming at me with a light strike.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Okaaay！ Here I come... Hyaaaah！」
Miyako-chan charges straight at me from the front and swings. It's genuinely childlike, straightforward, and refreshing.
As I block her strikes, I start feeling refreshed myself.

name: Miyako
message: 「Hah, yaaah！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, there！ Good job, Miyako-chan！ That's the spirit！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Tah！ Hyaaaah！」
Without counterattacking, I keep blocking Miyako-chan's strikes.
Yet even from just this, I can tell this kid's abilities are head and shoulders above the rest.
She unleashes relentless flurries while constantly reading two or three moves ahead; at the very least, she'd easily pry open the guard of anyone her own age.

name: Miyako
message: 「Yaaaaah！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, yeah, nice！ At this rate, you're going to grow up to be an amazing swordswoman, Miyako-chan！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, I will！ 'Cause I'm aiming to be the strongest swordswoman in the world！」
Taking my praise in stride, she says it as if it's only natural.
Whether it's the fruit of gifted training, innate talent, or both, her mental fortitude is something else too.

name: Iori
message: （This kid really is amazing...！）
As I block another one of Miyako―chan's attacks, admiring her like that―

name: Miyako
message: 「...Mmph.」
Miyako-chan suddenly stops swinging.

name: Iori
message: 「Huh, what's wrong？ Did you get tired？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Boring.」

name: Iori
message: 「B-Boring？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I mean, you're not fighting back at all, Sensei！ This is no different from fighting a scarecrow~」

name: Miyako
message: 「If you don't get serious, fighting isn't any fun！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm... You might actually have a point there.」
Right—no matter how small she is, she's a full-fledged swordswoman. Holding back too much would be disrespectful.

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry about that. Alright then, this time I'll come at you too.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Okay, please do!」
I'm obviously not going to go all out—but I'd like to see how her defense holds up too.
To coach her on both offense and defense, I step in and launch a strike of my own—

name: Iori
message: 「Well, let's start with... maybe something like this？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Ngh, hup！」
Starting off light—she parried that without any trouble.

name: Miyako
message: 「Teacher, you can go harder than that, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright. I'll ramp it up little by little from here.」
As if testing Miyako's defensive capabilities, I began to increase the level of my attacks, step by step.
Not just speed and power, but also the complexity of my blade path, gradually raising the difficulty of her defense.

name: Miyako
message: 「That's—this way！ Hah！」

name: Iori
message: 「You blocked that too? Well then, how about this！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Whoa！」
Miyako has quick reflexes like a child, and a sharp eye.
Though that also means she’s easily baited by feints. In fact, she did fall for one, but—
even then, she managed to steady herself and block the strike.

name: Iori
message: 「Miyako, that's amazing！ It’s not often someone can block that！」

name: Miyako
message: 「You attacked from such a weird spot all of a sudden, it really surprised me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. I wonder if things will get too difficult from here on out？」
From there, I kicked the level up even higher.
You could say it was a light psychological battle, anticipating that she could see through simple feints.
Even so, the speed was such that an average first―year student at the academy wouldn't have been able to keep up―

name: Miyako
message: 「Since the last one was like that, it's gotta be here！」

name: Iori
message: 「...That's incredible, to be able to block this too.」

name: Miyako
message: 「This is actually pretty fun. Uh... how about this！」
While saying that lightly, Miyako launched an attack with the exact same feint I had just used.

name: Miyako
message: 「There's no rule saying I can't counterattack, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course not.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Then let's do more!♪」
Looking like she was having fun, Miyako launched even more attacks at me.
It was an imitation of my earlier moves, yet she already seemed to be incorporating her own unique variations.

name: Miyako
message: 「Ya, tah！ Hah！」
Accounting for the difference in our builds, she didn't attack from overhead, instead choosing to barrage me with hard-to-avoid strikes from below, leveraging the height gap.
Her movements undoubtedly show she knows exactly what a 'fight' is.

name: Iori
message: 「Heave-ho...！ Well then, how about this！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Whoa, you really did it! Ahaha!♪」
I had performed a parry anticipating a counter from the start, but Miyako-chan managed to respond to even that attack.
I suppose it means she had read that move entirely.

name: Iori
message: （I'm stunned... she's a genius, no doubt about it.）
Like Momiji, Miyako-chan excels at reading the flow. She saw through my blade's trajectory and reacted to it instantly.
Normally, however, her young body shouldn't possess the sheer physical strength to make that possible—

name: Iori
message: （So she's supplementing all that missing strength with Tenju.）
Yet, to compensate for such a small frame, the spiritual sensory value required is far from ordinary.
There are probably many among the graduates, let alone the first-years at the academy, who couldn't match Miyako-chan's spiritual sensory value.

name: Iori
message: （This girl is going to be someone truly incredible in the future...！）
Just as my heart was racing with joy and expectation―Miyako―chan suddenly stopped moving.

name: Iori
message: 「What's wrong？ Are you tired out, at last？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Nope. That's not it, but—Sensei, you have even more amazing techniques you can use, right？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I heard about it from Big Sister. The 'Swordsman-Killer', was it？」

name: Iori
message: 「O-oh... well, I suppose so.」
I cast a sharp glare at Momiji.
Why on earth did she tell Miyako-chan something like that? She's a troublesome one.

name: Miyako
message: 「Hey Sensei, I want to see that！ Do it, please！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, I really can't do that.」

name: Iori
message: 「That isn't something I can just show off. It was supposed to be a secret, even from Momiji.」

name: Miyako
message: 「No way...」
When I said that, Miyako-chan let her shoulders drop in disappointment.
Pouting, she looked up at me with eyes that were glistening, somehow...

name: Miyako
message: 「Is there really no way...？ I was so looking forward to having someone as strong as you, Sensei, show me a super-amazing move...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh...！ But that's... that's just too much...」

name: Miyako
message: 「Senseeei...」
S-stop it... looking at me with eyes like that...！

name: Miyako
message: 「Please... come on Sensei, please...」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, fine！ Just for a little bit, okay？」
No, this is impossible, I couldn't handle it.

name: Miyako
message: 「Yay！ Thank you！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Teacher, you’re such a pushover.」
I mean, what else was I supposed to do? How could I ever ignore a kid's request? That would be inhumane.

name: Iori
message: 「A-anyway！ It’s really just for a little bit, you hear me？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Okay！」
Her cheerful response makes me happy, yet at the same time, I feel hesitant to unleash *that* on such a kid...

name: Iori
message: （Can't be helped. Just for a split second...）
I switch gears and focus my consciousness.

name: Iori
message: 「Tengen Saimei―ryuu―here I come.」
In that instant, Momiji, who had been merely watching from the sidelines, seemed to flinch as if she had caught a glimpse of my murderous intent.
But Miyako, on the other hand—

name: Miyako
message: 「Whoa...！ Teacher, you’re completely different from a second ago...！ Is this you being serious？ That’s amazing...！」
Despite being hit head-on by my killing intent, she didn't show any fear, nor was she moved by it.
She just looked happy, her eyes shining with excitement.

name: Miyako
message: 「So cool, so cool! Where am I supposed to strike? I can’t tell at all... this is amazing~」
She continues to stand in her guard against me, trying to find an opening to strike.
Of course, it seemed she couldn't find one―yet Miyako―chan looked even happier still.

name: Miyako
message: 「I’ve never seen anything like this before. Thank you, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: （It throws me off my game, but... is it just because she’s a child？）
Is curiosity simply outweighing her fear? Or is Miyako―chan just incredibly composed―
Just as I was thinking that.

name: Miyako
message: 「You use so many feints it makes my head spin! Uhm... maybe something like this...!」
Miyako-chan assumes a stance imitating mine.
No―she wasn't just imitating the stance; she was imitating the very essence of the Saimei―ryuu.
While it didn't quite reach the level of true killing intent, the pressure from her precise movements, blended with a flurry of feints, was unmistakably that of the Saimei-ryuu.

name: Iori
message: （Th-this is...！）

name: Miyako
message: 「Alright, here I go！」
While I was still taken aback, Miyako-chan lunged at me in one burst.
At first, it was a straightforward, honest strike, the kind meant to force a defense. But the next one—

name: Miyako
message: 「First, from the right！」
A diagonal slash from the left. I block it.

name: Miyako
message: 「Next, from above！」
After extending her body as if to leap, she immediately sank down to my feet, aiming a strike at my knees.
I stepped back, lifting my leg slightly to avoid it—

name: Miyako
message: 「Once more, this time from above！」
Feinting as if to continue her pursuit, she suddenly leaped up, aiming for my upper guard.
I caught that as well, but Miyako-chan used my blade as a foothold to perform an acrobatic backflip.
Foothold might be a stretch; she just used the recoil from her arm strength to vault away... though I suppose that, too, is a gift of the muscle augmentation from Tenju.

name: Iori
message: 「N-no way, how could this be...！」
As she is only mimicking the superficial aspects, it is easily within my power to parry for now.
Although, the fact that she can mimic even the surface is itself abnormal...

name: Miyako
message: 「Hehe, this is fun！」
To my predicament, Miyako-chan looked as delighted as if she had just received a new toy.
In truth, for Miyako-chan, it probably is much the same thing.

name: Miyako
message: 「It’s so much fun to confuse people while fighting; I’ve never fought like this before!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hehe, I think I’ll try using this on all sorts of people from now on.」
Miyako-chan is greedy for strength.
If she gets a glimpse of power the likes of which she has never known, she must find it impossibly thrilling.

name: Iori
message: （That part of her is childlike and fine, but...）
I am stunned by her talent and it is certainly worthy of praise, but I cannot allow her to learn the Tengen Saimei-ryuu.
Not because it is a secret technique—but because this is a killing sword.

name: Iori
message: 「...Sorry, Miyako-chan, but let’s bring this to an end.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Eh—？ I want you to teach me more~！ Because this looks super strong！」

name: Iori
message: 「Unfortunately, I cannot do that.」
When faced with the Saimei-ryuu, one has no choice but to challenge it with the Saimei-ryuu.
I originally had no intention of attacking in this state, but it is unavoidable now.

name: Miyako
message: 「Sensei, you’re serious？ I won’t lose！」
I lunged forward at full speed toward an eager Miyako-chan！

name: Miyako
message: 「If this one is here, then—gotcha！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Huh！？」
I stepped in the exact opposite direction of where Miyako was striking, crossing her path widely.
From Miyako's perspective, it must have looked like I had suddenly vanished.
I continued to trail her blind spot, sweeping my blade across her wide―open torso―！

name: Miyako
message: 「Kyaa！」
My strike knocked Miyako's Origami flying, and she collapsed from the impact.
The deflected Origami bounced a few times in the distance before coming to a stop....

name: Iori
message: 「...S-sorry, Miyako！ Are you okay！？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Ah, I lost~」
I rushed over in a panic, but Miyako stood up with a springy hop, looking surprisingly energetic.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you hurt anywhere？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yep, I'm fine. Though it's frustrating that I lost. But that was fun！」

name: Iori
message: 「...I see, that's good then.」
She really didn't seem to be injured, so I felt relieved.

name: Miyako
message: 「I learned an interesting way to fight, too! I'll try using it next time!」

name: Iori
message: 「No... wait a second, Miyako. You can't use that last one.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Eh~？ But that was the funnest part.」

name: Iori
message: 「That move, you see, puts a huge strain on your body.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you use it now, you might ruin your body and end up unable to practice Jindou in the future.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm... is that so.」
...Well, that was a lie to get her to give up on it. Miyako believed me completely and pouted, looking troubled.

name: Iori
message: 「So, keep it under wraps for now, and come back to learn it again when you’re a bit older.」

name: Iori
message: 「I think I'll be able to teach you more properly then.」

name: Miyako
message: 「...Alright. If Sensei says so, I won't use it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s a good girl！ Good job, you’re a champ.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, Miyako can become an incredibly strong swordswoman without using techniques like that.」
I patted her head as I praised her.
Miyako looked genuinely happy and smiled, saying, 『I definitely will！』

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, shall we head back to everyone else?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Coming！」
Miyako―chan replied energetically. She was as childishly cute as ever, but―

name: Iori
message: （...She reacted to my final strike.）
It should have been an unblockable, guaranteed-kill strike, layered with feint upon feint.
Yet, Miyako-chan had managed to parry it, albeit barely, from an awkward position.
As a result, she couldn't maintain her stance and ended up getting her Origami knocked away—

name: Iori
message: （If Miyako-chan had the physique and experience of an adult...）
And if she could use the Tengen Saimei-ryuu at that moment.

name: Iori
message: （...No, I shouldn't think about the worst-case scenario.）
Miyako-chan is a pure and cute girl. She promised not to use it, and surely, she wouldn't misuse it.
